pages.title: about
pages.bodyHtml:
about david

David Hahn is a Sydney based photographer with over 40 years experience in the industry, he was lucky to discover a passion for photography within his High School curriculum, firstly working in television and then extensively for some of Australia’s most popular magazine publications with works published in The Australian Women’s Weekly, Womans Day, New Idea, WHO magazine and TV Week; to name a few!

He enjoys the everyday diversity of photography; celebrity portraits, fashion, family & real life, food and travel.

David thrives when working with a team. He enjoys the collaboration of a talented and creative crew to fulfil the clients brief and help gain exceptional results.

David is an easy going character who takes pride in every job, no matter how big or small.

If you would like to book David for a photoshoot, please be in touch.

·      Graduated Diploma of Photography Sydney TAFE

·      Network TEN

·      ACP Magazines

·      Bauer Media

·      Freelancing

FINALIST

2018 - HEAD ON Photo Festival Portrait

2011 - Photographer Of The Year : ACP Magazines

2006 - National Photographic Portrait Prize
